response.overview: An analog Super 8 work featuring hand-drawn animation on celluloid and sound recorded partly on magnetic tape. The film embodies the mechanics of memory: a familiar face from the past that you cannot hold in your gaze; an image you struggle to grasp upon waking. Like memory itself, the celluloid and magnetic tape disintegrate: the image vanishes, distorts, develops blind spots, and dissolves into noise.
response.tagline: An analog Super 8 work featuring hand-drawn animation on celluloid and sound recorded partly on magnetic tape.
response.title: Do you remember me?
